verdict.rationale: The docs describe an isolated execution environment: the Agent API `sandbox` tool gives the agent an isolated Linux container for running code, and Computer can execute code in an interactive Linux sandbox. This is code-execution isolation, not a test-mode or staging environment separate from production API data or accounts, so it covers the story only tangentially. Missing for 10: a dedicated test/sandbox API mode or test keys, separation of test and production data or billing, docs on safe testing workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
